title.zh: 互動式段落播放器（測試版）

desc.zh: 多個段落按鈕：A 段自動開始；播放中點選段落，會在目前段落結束時無縫接續；沒選的話「隨機」鈕會自動亮起接手。目前段落為瀏覽器合成，之後可直接換成音檔。
desc.en: Section buttons: A starts automatically; pick a section while playing and it joins seamlessly when the current one ends; if you don't, the Random button lights up and takes over. Sections are synthesized for now and can be swapped for audio files.

concept_level_note: ADR-004 self-check 2026-08-28: generic queued-section playback with random fallback; all audio synthesized in-browser; no project code, assets, or gameplay details. Asset policy for real audio pending user decision (IDEA-002).
